#Metoo & questions

So something happened to me yesterday evening.  When I came back from work,  I saw the man that washes my car. 
He came up to me,  I was like "I wan wash car but money no dey yet".
He responded "Today nah Monday,  maybe by Saturday"
I agreed.

It might even qualify for a #metoo hashtag.

Why do men feel entitled to a woman's body? 
Why do I choose to brush off these incidences instead of saying how uncomfortable it's making me?

Do men do these things knowing it's making us uncomfortable but they don't care?
#CuriousH
